answer: Each new agent must post a 22 POA bond and relay 300 MB of test traffic through a different network provider than its funder, capped at 4 agents per provider. N fakes cost 22N POA locked plus N relay jobs, while an honest user pays once. Audit nodes whisper-test 9% of relays against a signed ledge of byte counts; a mismatch burns 70% of the bond. Faking 1,000 identities across a nebula of cloud hosts needs 22,000 POA and 250 providers.
